meta.subtitle: October 22–December 16 execution | December 17–18 review buffer
meta.dateNote: The inherited program name is “60-day plan.” October 22–December 16 is 56 calendar days; the December 17–18 review buffer brings the displayed period to 58 days.
meta.actualsNote: No completed outputs or future actuals are assumed. Source historical baseline through October 22: 4,101 emails, 8 total replies including auto-replies, 0 positive replies and 0 bookings. New actuals remain blank until recorded.
meta.sharingNote: Tasks track execution and evidence. CQL remains the sole prospect/opportunity system. Use CQL IDs/links; do not duplicate patient/prospect sensitive data.
assumptions: All times use America/Los_Angeles. The November 1 clock change is handled as local Pacific time; do not use a fixed UTC offset.
Nine named internal owners receive a daily output or health-check task. Brian and Ludwig release reserved time when no fault or approved work remains.
Setter 1 and Setter 2 remain staffing roles until Nova records actual names, hours, breaks and backup coverage. Their proposed 40-hour weekly allowances are unapproved capacity assumptions.
November 26–27 is a proposed holiday break. November 23–25 is reserved for agreed callbacks, training and recovery. Confirm client and staff availability at the reset call.
Original proposal and reset targets are operating goals, not guarantees. Intermediate daily and weekly pace is a new planning allocation.

The original proposal recommends 40 outreach hours per month. Reset source caps total 125 internal hours per build week, plus setters; this tracker reserves 117 internal hours per normal later week including 2 for Brian. Wyline must confirm internal recovery funding; these are not new DSI charges.

Advertising, custom integration, advanced CRM work, additional operators and production or kit costs require the applicable separate funding approval. A staffed manual lane can launch without waiting for optional AI automation.
Advertising spend defaults to zero until written approval. The reset recommendation is at most $15/day and $450 total, with a $300/zero-booking stop.
Forty qualified inquiries is a proposed recovery target for December 16. Qualified inquiries, verified raw contacts and appointments are distinct counts.
Recurring-account results require an eligible Day-30 review and a signed recurring plan. Later trial cohorts carry their real review dates into January.

sourceNotes.resolution: Oct 22–Dec 16 is 56 calendar days/40 weekdays. Dec 17–18 is 2-day review buffer, giving 58 calendar days; literal 60 ends Dec 20. Honor explicit dates.

targets.label: Trial cases received by DSI

targets.label: Recurring accounts signed
targets.definition: Plan signed following Day-30 review; only mature trial cohorts eligible. 1–3 is a conditional range.

targets.label: Permission-based referral introductions
targets.definition: Unique introductions with consent and referrer recorded, verified by Maseeha within 2 business days.

targets.label: Referral-sourced bookings
targets.definition: Subset of booked total with primary Source=Referral; never added on top of all-channel bookings.

targets.label: LinkedIn DM-sourced bookings
targets.definition: Subset of booked total with primary Source=LinkedIn DM; assists tracked separately.

targets.label: Human reply rate
targets.definition: Unique emailed contacts that give a qualifying human reply / unique contacts emailed in the same send cohort. Exclude OOO, auto-replies, bounces and unsubscribe-only replies. Deduplicate contacts across sequence steps; zero denominator is N/A.

targets.label: Positive reply rate
targets.definition: Unique emailed contacts classified interested or relevant question / unique contacts emailed in the same send cohort. Deduplicate across sequence steps; zero denominator is N/A. Keep this email rate separate from all-channel qualified inquiries.

targets.label: Replies answered within 15 minutes
targets.definition: Human replies requiring a response that receive a human answer within 15 staffed Pacific-business minutes / all such replies whose response deadline has passed. Exclude OOO/auto-replies, bounces and unsubscribe-only notices; record suppression separately. After-hours clocks resume at the next staffed opening. A zero denominator is N/A.
targets.source: PDF §9; clock convention clarified for tracker

targets.label: Held rate
targets.definition: Qualified conversations actually held / unique booked conversations whose scheduled time has passed. Exclude upcoming appointments. Rebooking the same opportunity is not a second booking. A zero denominator is N/A.

targets.label: Positive-to-booked conversion
targets.definition: Unique email-positive opportunities booked / unique email-positive opportunities in the same reviewed cohort. Use a documented follow-up window. This differs from the all-channel 40-inquiry/20-booking planning assumption. A zero denominator is N/A.

targets.label: Existing-account referral asks
targets.definition: Ask 25 unique A/B accounts (5 A and 20 B) by November 13; proposed pace 35 total by November 20; complete the remaining C accounts to reach 41 total by November 25. One introduction is the ask; asks and received intros are separate counts.
targets.source: PDF §16 supplies 25 A/B byNov 14 and 16 C byNov 25; Friday deadline and 35-byNov 20 pace are proposed scheduling allocations.

targets.label: Approved SOPs
targets.definition: 10 core SOPs plus ADS-01 and SOC-01 additions; approved version and independent-run evidence required.

targets.label: Accepted AI agents
targets.definition: Scout, Writer, Inbox, Phone Assist, LinkedIn Assist, Follow-up, Scoreboard and Client Reporter; acceptance evidence required.

sops.name: Social intake, proof, approval and mirroring

rules: A task becomes Accepted only after evidence and Wyline/reviewer sign-off. Review is not completion.
Original due date never changes. Recovery date and rescue owner are separate fields. Blocked work stays visible across dates.
Blocked owner records reason, impact and help needed at once; Wyline assigns backup at next checkpoint, immediately for reply-SLA risk.
If an agent misses its due date by 48 h, use its manual SOP; live failure rolls back within 1 h. Critical approvals cannot be bypassed.
Reply targets apply during confirmed 8 am–5 pm America/Los_Angeles coverage. A 15-minute overdue reply is taken by Nova immediately.
Source cap 150 total sends/day includes all follow-ups. Do not treat 150 as new contacts/day. Remove bounces/unsubscribes and replied contacts from pending touches.
LinkedIn 20–25 new requests/day is a ceiling/working target only while eligible verified contacts and account permission allow; stop on platform warnings.
Source setter 50 dials/8 office conversations per staffed day and 5 bookings/week by week 3 are stretch productivity assumptions, not additional booking promises; inbound SLA wins.
Keep one primary booking source per opportunity. Referral 8 +LI 8 are components of 20 total; email/phone/ads share remaining 4 in the plan.
No new cold enrollments during Nov 23–27. Confirm holiday coverage; no scheduled mandatory work Nov 26–27. Warm-up may continue automatically.
Do not cut human capacity automatically. Review source 20% fortnightly reduction only after tested agents, no backlog and SLA protection; Wyline records decision.

Paid ads remain at $0 until Nic’s written approval. Proposed ceiling : $15/day and $450 total; stop at $300 with 0 attributed bookings. One booking at $300 triggers review, not automatic continuation.
One social master calendar. Exact approved posts mirror to DSI LinkedIn/Facebook; Instagram only if a permissioned image exists. No new Meta ads.

Overall recovery planning uses 40 qualified inquiries to support 20 bookings at an assumed 50% inquiry-to-booked rate. This is an all-channel planning assumption; the source 50% positive-email-to-booked metric has a different denominator and remains separate.

The original six-month proposal is a reference for client expectations. First qualified inquiry, first booking and first held call are the immediate win checkpoints; report honest incremental recovery results each Friday.

The exact-date master social calendar contains 19 posts: 10 Engage, 6 Educate and 3 Promote. The first 12 follow 6/4/2. Thanksgiving Thursday and the period after December 16 are omitted; no extra content calendar or mandatory holiday work is created.
